description:
Which model should I use for this task? Maps the task text to a category (coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge,
        web design, or overall when nothing matches) by a fixed keyword map, filters by output price per million tokens, context
        length and open weights, and ranks by that category's benchmark board. Deterministic, no LLM call. Returns top_k models with
        scores, rank, prices, context, page URLs and a one-line reason. overall is the LLMBenchmark Index: a weighted mean of the Vibe Coding Index, the agentic, reasoning, math and knowledge indexes, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the LMArena text Elo, with a 90% margin.
name: recommend_model
